column3: Parallel double negation: a provision neither builds sufficiency nor relieves need, clarifying failed benefit.
Qualifies the nearby failure of mutual aid with mercy as the sole exception.
Contrasts the claimed self-sufficiency behind withholding with 77:31's exposed insufficiency.
Direct parallel: neither a patron nor reciprocal patronage can avail on the decisive day.
The command toward what was denied begins the immediate movement into the failed shade.
Directly joins wealth and children failing to avail with enduring fire.
Supplies the preceding smoke-shade that 77:31 declares neither shelter nor protection.
Names the three-branched shade whose inadequacy 77:31 immediately specifies.
Parallel reversal: enjoyed benefit does not avail when the outcome arrives.
Direct parallel: plotted defense neither avails nor receives external help.
The challenge to produce a plan reinforces that no devised escape offsets the scene.
Contrasts voluntary self-sufficiency with the verse's lack of any sufficient refuge.
Directly denies that acquisitions or chosen protectors can avail before Jahannam.
Parallel failure of allied support before Allah, while retaining the contrast of true guardianship.
Directly pairs wealth and children that do not avail with becoming fuel for the fire.
Extends failed efficacy to an object of worship that neither perceives nor avails.
Continues the same referent by showing the flame's castle-like sparks.
Contrasting reading: Allah's independence makes no created support necessary to Him.
Contrasts the non-shade of 77:31 with extended shade in the alternate scene.
Continues the fire image with its large, moving yellow forms.
Contrasts rejection and turning away with Allah's unaffected independence.
Shares the explicit lahab fire term, concentrating the flame motif.
The recurring woe marks the evaluative consequence surrounding the failed refuge.
Secondary contrast: Allah's independence frames benefit as relational good rather than mere giving.
The name Lahab supplies only a lexical-fire echo.
Refused forward movement offers a contrary posture to the commanded movement toward judgment.
Contrasting reading: complete divine ownership is paired with independence from need.
Uses a different sense of zalla; it offers only a lexical, non-refuge parallel.
The silence immediately following the fire sequence removes speech as another possible recourse.
Secondary contrast: defective offerings do not create the benefit their transfer might claim.
Uses a different sense of zalla, with no clear shelter function.
The repeated woe sustains the judgment refrain after the failed shade.
Direct parallel: wealth does not avail at the moment of falling.
A burned object of devotion echoes failed reliance, but zalla here is not shade.
The woe refrain closes the challenge to human scheming.
Apparent sufficiency can conceal need; a secondary caution against judging provision by appearance.
Direct contrast between shade and scorching heat sharpens what a true shade would do.
No material addition to shade, flame, or failed protection.
Direct parallel: amassed numbers and pride do not avail.
Completes the smoke-shade contrast: it is neither cool nor beneficent.
Denial of permission to excuse shows a second failed recourse in the same judgment sequence.
Parallel failure of something insufficient to replace truth, at a different evidentiary level.
A general contrast of darkness and light, without the shelter or flame function.
The assembled Day of Separation supplies the setting in which the shade fails.
Direct parallel: accumulated gains do not avail when reckoning overtakes their holders.
A contrary command of submission and nearness, without a direct refuge link.
No material addition to the focus.
Secondary reading on receiving sufficiency from Allah, not the failure of shade.
Direct parallel: conjecture does not avail in place of truth.
Contrasts the failed shade with the protective shades assigned to the mindful.
Secondary contrast: available means do not excuse chosen withdrawal.
Fruit imagery is only a distant provision contrast.
The gathering of a plot weakly parallels the later futility of schemes.
Direct parallel: strength, traces, and acquisitions do not avail their possessors.
Supplies the surrounding heat and boiling water of the same smoke-shade scene.
The desired fruits form the positive provision contrast immediately after the fire sequence.
Secondary contrast: divine independence prevents benefit from being a need supplied to Allah.
Contrasts the failed shade with a lasting, emphatic shade in the rewarded scene.
Directly denies any protective guard against Allah, reinforcing the absence of refuge.
Direct parallel: inherited claims and what was earned do not avail at the outcome.
No material addition to the focus.
The command to eat and drink supplies the positive recompense contrast.
Secondary reading: sufficiency may come from Allah rather than an assumed material channel.
Direct first-person parallel: wealth fails exactly when its supposed protective function is tested.
No material addition to shade, flame, or failed efficacy.
Within the fire, former followers ask leaders to relieve a share, exposing failed protection.
Directly limits a practical precaution: it may answer a need but cannot avail against Allah.
The reward formula establishes the contrasting outcome for those who act well.
Contrasts human dependence with Allah's complete sufficiency.
No material addition to the focus.
The unjust become Jahannam's firewood, extending the combustible-fire outcome.
A secondary, contrary sense of yughni: each person is absorbed by an inescapable personal affair.
Transforms covering layers into layers of fire above and below, an anti-shelter parallel.
The repeated woe seals the contrast between recompense and denial.
Contrasts human response with Allah's independence and individual accountability.
Contrasts the failed shade with relaxed, inhabited shades in the rewarded scene.
Individual seeing of even slight evil weakly supports the unavoidable judgment context.
Direct parallel: even intercession does not avail except under Allah's permission.
Lack of capacity and route is only a distant contrast to effective escape.
Brief enjoyment is set against the impending judgment and fire sequence.
Secondary reading: sufficiency and possession are given, not self-secured.
No material addition to the focus.
No material addition beyond a general confrontation with transgression.
Directly limits precautionary planning: dispersed entry cannot avail against Allah.
Contrasts enduring garden shade with the fire as the other final outcome.
The final woe continues the recurring verdict on deniers.
Contrasts created replaceability with the merciful Lord's independence.
Uses a different sense of ghaniya, supplying only a remote lexical echo.
Turning away weakly parallels the deniers framed by the surrounding woes.
Secondary contrast: enrichment and lack of any protector can coexist in a failed response.
No material addition to the focus.
The absence of idle speech only distantly echoes the later silence motif.
No material addition to shade, flame, or failed protection.
No material addition to the focus.
No escape from Allah weakly reinforces the failure of any protective alternative.
No material addition to the focus.
The image of unprotected falling offers a distant contrary-refuge echo.
Distributed punishment supports the broader judgment setting, without a direct shade link.
No material addition to the focus.
Reward for those who do good is only a broad counterpart to the punitive scene.
Defines a true shade by its protective function against heat, making 77:31's negation exact by contrast.
Direct parallel: wealth and children do not benefit on the decisive day.
Directly denies that wealth and acquisition avail, immediately before the lahab fire.
Direct parallel: wealth and children do not avail against Allah; the continuation assigns fire.
False gods fail to avail their worshippers when the command arrives.
Hearing, sight, and hearts do not avail when the signs are denied.
Wealth's collapse exposes the absence of any supporting faction or helper besides Allah.
Alleged gods cannot help their devotees, reversing the expected protection relation.
Treats adopted gods as a hoped-for source of might, a directly contrary shelter claim.
The hoped-for divine support reverses into disavowal and opposition.
Rejects appeal to what can neither harm nor benefit, parallel to a refuge that cannot function.
Denies that invoked alternatives can remove or redirect harm.
Contrasts reliance on what neither benefits nor harms with return after misdirection.
The Day's isolation begins with intimates unable to be asked about one another, reinforcing failed human recourse.
The sinner's proposed ransom by children supplies a counterpart to aid that cannot secure escape.
A ransom of earth-full gold is not accepted, showing that exchange cannot avert the fire outcome.
Even earth-full gold doubled as ransom cannot release its possessors from punishment.
The offered earth-full ransom is not accepted, preserving the no-substitute reading.
Wealth and children do not bring nearness; their presumed protective capital is decentered.
Wealth and children are not security but become a means of punishment in this world and death in denial.
Repeats the reversal of wealth and children from apparent provision to punitive circumstance.
Warns that wealth and children can distract from remembrance, a secondary route by which provision fails.
Frames wealth and children as trial rather than autonomous security.
Fire fueled by people and stones supplies the material opposite of protective shade.
Those worshipped and worshippers become fuel for Jahannam, collapsing counterfeit protection into combustion.
The fire whose fuel is people and stones reinforces the anti-shelter and fuel motifs.
The kindled fire of Allah adds a concentrated flame counterpart.
An enclosing fire provides the contrary image to shade as cover or enclosure.
The intensely hot fire supplies a direct heat counterpart to a shade that cannot protect.
Repeated burning and replacement of skins develops the bodily consequence of unprotected flame.
The threat of being made to enter Saqar develops the punitive-fire sequence.
Saqar's destructive persistence intensifies the no-relief reading.
Near, low shade in the rewarded scene is a clear positive counterpart to 77:31.
The extending and contracting shade supplies a neutral creation-level contrast to the counterfeit shade.
The cloud's shading of a people supplies a provision-and-protection contrast.
Cloud shade with provision forms a positive counterpart to failed shade and failed relief.
Cloud shade with provision reiterates the positive counterpart in a second setting.
